tagline.en: A friend to talk your project through

whatsapp_message.id: Halo EngiFren, saya mau ngobrolin proyek.
whatsapp_message.en: Hi EngiFren, I'd like to talk about a project.

lead.id: Punya masalah teknik atau ide alat? EngiFren menghitung, mendesain, membuat, memprogram, dan menguji sampai alatnya benar-benar bekerja.
lead.en: Got an engineering problem or an idea for a device? EngiFren calculates, designs, builds, programs, and tests it until it actually works.

desc.id: Neraca massa dan energi, perpindahan panas, sizing alat, pemodelan dan optimasi proses.
desc.en: Mass and energy balances, heat transfer, equipment sizing, process modeling and optimization.

desc.id: CAD, gambar siap fabrikasi, alat custom, dan modifikasi mesin yang sudah ada.
desc.en: CAD, fabrication-ready drawings, custom equipment, and modifications to existing machines.

desc.id: Sensor suhu, aliran, dan tekanan; mikrokontroler; sistem kontrol; akuisisi data dan antarmuka.
desc.en: Temperature, flow, and pressure sensing; microcontrollers; control systems; data acquisition and interfaces.

desc.id: Mesin proof-of-concept, alat laboratorium, sistem proses skala kecil, dan peralatan eksperimen.
desc.en: Proof-of-concept machines, lab equipment, small process systems, and experimental apparatus.

desc.id: Mesin tidak bekerja semestinya, salah pilih komponen, atau kinerja kurang: didiagnosis lalu diperbaiki.
desc.en: Machines that underperform, wrong component choices, or failures: diagnosed, then fixed.
Talk it through, define the problem and target.

text.id: Setiap penawaran dirinci: berapa untuk material, komponen, fabrikasi, dan berapa biaya engineering. Nilai kerja engineering tidak disembunyikan di dalam harga material.
text.en: Every quote is itemized: how much goes to materials, components, fabrication, and how much is the engineering fee. Engineering work is never hidden inside material prices.

title.id: Satu engineer, dari awal sampai selesai

text.id: Orang yang kamu ajak ngobrol adalah orang yang sama yang menghitung, mendesain, membuat, memprogram, dan menguji alatnya. Tidak ada informasi yang hilang di antara bagian penjualan dan engineer. Berlatar belakang Teknik Kimia ITB, dengan pengalaman di desain 3D dan manufaktur, mekatronika, dan analisis kimia.
text.en: The person you talk to is the same person who calculates, designs, builds, programs, and tests your system. Nothing gets lost between a sales team and the engineers. Background in Chemical Engineering at ITB, with hands-on experience in 3D design and manufacturing, mechatronics, and chemical analysis.
